_comment: The awkward records. U-01: an answer matching no option at all — must survive as free text with needsReview, never be discarded. P-01: a multi whose OPTION LABEL itself contains the ' | ' separator, so a naive split corrupts it. E-01: an answered question with an empty-string answer, the shape defect D-C produces. W-01: a question already marked withdrawn, which must not vanish from storage.

questions.answer: Neither — use React context and stop adding libraries
